title: Generative AI and Large Language Models in Language Preservation: Opportunities and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic evaluation using a proposed analytical framework to assess LLM limitations, data scarcity, and accuracy challenges when applied to low-resource and endangered languages (e.g., Te Reo Māori) compared to dominant, high-resource languages.

Qualitative assessment via the framework's 'EthicalRiskLevel' metric and a case study, analyzing the risks of cultural dilution, loss of authenticity, and misrepresentation of indigenous knowledge in AI-generated content.
